title: The Scotch Game
description: White strikes in the center early with d4 on move three, opening lines quickly and steering the game away from the heavily analyzed Ruy Lopez.

sections.title: The Early d4 Break
sections.content: After 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.d4, White immediately challenges the center. Following 3...exd4 4.Nxd4, the position opens and both sides develop quickly.

positions.commentary: The Scotch Game. White breaks in the center with d4 on move three, opening the position for fast piece play.

sections.title: Active Piece Play
sections.content: With the center opened, White's knight sits actively on d4. The bishops gain scope and White develops with tempo, aiming for an early initiative against Black's position.

positions.commentary: After 4.Nxd4, White's pieces are active and the center is open. Black must develop carefully to neutralize White's lead in space.

exercises.title: Accept the Break
exercises.description: Black to play. Capture the d4 pawn to open the center.
